notes:
Fixes a startup error some of you saw after 1.41.10: a red bar reading “Some startup steps failed — Database initialise”.

It happened when the same account was set up twice on the same server under different capitals (ss71 and SS71). The tidy-up added in 1.41.10 tried to store both spellings the same way, which is not allowed for two separate entries, so it stopped — and the startup steps after it were skipped with it.

Nothing was lost. No account, password or setting was deleted on any version. The tidy-up now leaves such a pair alone and startup finishes normally. If you now see the same account twice on one server, that duplicate was always there — delete whichever one you do not use.

Also fixed: saving one of two such duplicates could write over the other one’s password and settings instead of its own.
